title: Simulate EWSR1 fusions across partners (FLI1/ERG/ETV1/ETV4/FEV) + breakpoint variants
context: M1 truth-set construction for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Builds the simulated positive set spanning the five canonical ES partners (FLI1, ERG, ETV1, ETV4, FEV) with documented breakpoint variants. All data is simulated (open/CC-licensed) per the guardrails; domain-expert review confirms the partner/breakpoint biology is plausible. This is the backbone the scoring library and full benchmark run against.
objective: Generate a >=200-case simulated truth set across the five ES partners with breakpoint variants, each case carrying a machine-readable ground-truth manifest and recorded provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: >=200 simulated cases spanning the five ES partners with documented breakpoints.
Each case has a machine-readable ground-truth manifest (genes, exact breakpoints, support counts, spike fraction); license CC-BY-4.0/CC0; provenance recorded.
Domain expert confirms partner/breakpoint biology is plausible.
output: data/sim/truthset-v1/ — >=200-case multi-partner simulated truth set with per-case ground-truth manifests.
